section:
64.11 lakh cognizable crime reported in 1997; 28.3 per cent increase over the decade 1987.
17.19 lakhs IPC crimes; 46.91 lakhs SLL crimes reported in this year.
12 Cognizable crimes reported on an average in 1 minute.
3 IPC crimes; 9 SLL crimes reported on an average in 1 minute.
0.6% increase in reported IPC crimes over last year.
1.9% decline in IPC crime rate over last year.
488.2 crime rate (IPC), highest reported from NCT of Delhi.
1 in every 4 reported IPC crimes is a violent crime in Nagaland, Manipur, Meghalaya, Tripura, Bihar and Assam; Delhi UT with highest crime rate in the country reported; 1 Violent crime in 14 reported IPC crimes.
3.3 per cent increase in Rape incidents; 5 per cent increase in Kidnapping & Abduction.
2.1 per cent decline in Dacoity cases.
61.5 per cent increase in Robbery cases in Nagaland; 23.1 per cent in Karnataka and 21.0 per cent in Tamil Nadu.
5 per cent increase in Kidnapping of Women & Girls; Dowry Deaths up by 8.9 per cent.
75.8 per cent IPC cases were investigated and 77.5 per cent of them were charge sheeted.
0.5 per cent share of Juvenile crimes to total IPC crimes down by 21.1 per cent over 1996.
47 per cent of Female arrestees under SLL crimes were from Tamil Nadu; Over 75% of them were held for Prohibition Act only.
4.7 per cent increase in Crimes against Women. Highest crime incidence in Maharashtra (16,270; 13.4%); highest crime rate in Delhi (21.9) as compared to 12.7 at All-India.
26.6 per cent increase in Child Rape (under 10 years of age); 7 per cent decline in Rape of Women above 30 years of age.
19.9 per cent; Crime against Children highest in Madhya Pradesh.
30.4 per cent; highest share in Crime against Scheduled Castes in Uttar Pradesh; 31.1 per cent share highest in Crime against Scheduled Tribes in Rajasthan.
61.6 per cent of the total Police casualties were due to Accidents.
